    conflicts=[]

 ntiles=len(shape_puz); ncols=ntiles+Hh*Ww
 rows=[]; colrows=[[] for _ in range(ncols)]
 for i,pts in enumerate(shape_puz):
  h=max(r for r,c,v in pts)+1;w=max(c for r,c,v in pts)+1
  M=np.full((h,w),4,int)
  for r,c,v in pts:M[r,c]=v
  opts=[]
  for k in (range(4) if allow_rot else [0]):
   Q=np.rot90(M,k).copy()
   if any(np.array_equal(Q,Z) for Z in opts):continue
   opts.append(Q)
   hh,ww=Q.shape;coords=[(r,c) for r in range(hh) for c in range(ww) if Q[r,c]!=4]
   for r0 in range(Hh-hh+1):
    for c0 in range(Ww-ww+1):
     cells=[(r0+r)*Ww+c0+c for r,c in coords]
     mask=1<<i
     for x in cells:mask|=1<<(ntiles+x)
     rid=len(rows);rows.append((i,k,r0,c0,cells,mask))
     for col in [i]+[ntiles+x for x in cells]:colrows[col].append(rid)
 colbits=[]
 for rr in colrows:
  b=0
  for rid in rr:b|=1<<rid
  colbits.append(b)
 conflicts=[]
 for row in rows:
  i,k,r,c,cells,mask=row;b=0
  for col in [i]+[ntiles+x for x in cells]:b|=colbits[col]
  conflicts.append(b)
 allcols=(1<<ncols)-1;nodes=0;sol=None;start=time.time()
 def rec(covered,avail,chosen):
  nonlocal nodes,sol
  nodes+=1
  if nodes>maxnodes or sol is not None:return
  if covered==allcols:sol=chosen.copy();return
  rem=allcols^covered;best=0;bestn=10**9
  while rem:
   b=rem&-rem;c=b.bit_length()-1;rem^=b
   opts=avail&colbits[c];n=opts.bit_count()
   if n==0:return
   if n<bestn:
    best,bestn=opts,n
    if n==1:break
  while best:
   b=best&-best;rid=b.bit_length()-1;best^=b
   i,k,r,c,cells,mask=rows[rid];cov=0
   for col in [i]+[ntiles+x for x in cells]:cov|=1<<col

 out=None

 return sol,out,nodes,time.time()-start,len(rows)
